annotations.title: Check if cleaning is taxable in a state

description: Says whether state sales tax (or the state's equivalent) applies to home (residential) and commercial cleaning services in one US state or DC, from EosLog's state by state reference. Each answer is what that state's own official pages say, with the official source links, the state base rate where the source states one, and the date it was checked. It is not tax advice and does not cover local taxes.

audience.description: home for residential cleaning, commercial for offices and other businesses, or both.

state.description: Two-letter code (TX) or full name (Texas). DC is included.
